findings.description: F-001: new-round.png and new-match.png were byte-identical, so the lesson that exists to contrast the two states illustrated them with the same image, and neither showed the score row the captions describe.
findings.resolution: Fixed by the StringVar(master=root) repair and regeneration. md5 comparison now confirms new-round.png differs from new-match.png, and the two figures visibly show a preserved score versus a zeroed one -- exactly the contrast the lesson teaches.
